name: OpenVibe.MediaHub

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed (an upload in flight is cut; the person resumes it from its parts)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are cookies verified against Network's keys, fetched again at boot
a chunked upload session survives the restart: its parts are in Media, and the page resumes from the missing ones until the session expires (MEDIAHUB_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0003 only create MediaHub's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the three domains

notes: Port 4990, unit openvibe-media-hub.service, one process for openvibe.download, openvibe.pics and openvibe.video (plan T10 D4, by Host header). v1: openvibe.download is a private drive — account-only uploads streamed into OpenVibe.Media (app media-hub; a plain form up to 256 MB, resumable multipart beyond), private files and folders with per-person limits, share links that expire, need a signed-in downloader and may name accounts (matched by subject), reports that suspend a share for staff, and sandboxed attachment downloads. The video.*/pics.*/download.* capabilities stay planned until an app may call them. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client media-hub, JWKS, identity.subject.resolve) and OpenVibe.Media; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033). Since 2026-10-12 the same process serves openvibe.video, OpenVibe.Video v1: public, read-only watch pages for OpenVibe.Live's stream recordings and clips (read from Live's public API, files on OpenVibe.Media), with WebVTT captions from the AI transcript and chapters from the AI moments. Its playlists (MediaHub#31) have an API for people and apps since 0.152.0 (video.playlist.read, video.playlist.manage; MediaHub#33); video.vod.read stays planned (the watch pages are public HTML). Since 2026-10-15 it serves openvibe.pics, OpenVibe.Pics (MediaHub#64): signed-in picture uploads re-encoded without metadata (sharp), stored as private Media objects and served only through /i/<slug>.<ext>, unlisted pages with share and embed links, albums, reports (child-safety hides at once, 3 distinct hide) and staff takedowns that blocklist the sha256 and difference hash; signed-out uploads are built but off until the DMCA agent and the CSAM hash-matching account exist.

site.name: Video
site.tagline: Past streams, clips and your drive
site.what: A 25 GB drive with share links and folder backups (openvibe.download), videos you upload or record with AI captions, chapters and the AI cut, plus Live's recordings (openvibe.video), and pictures with embed links, albums, any size and format, and alt text (openvibe.pics).
